mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (indicating a weaker labor market) compresses corporate earnings growth expectations and increases risk aversion, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE is above 10%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate to below 10% over the past month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings outlook and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE falls below 10.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deterioration in the labor market (high unemployment rate) and industrial production (low manufacturing output) signals a severe economic contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 10% and INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3% annually), the Federal Reserve is expected to implement monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 800,000 units signals reduced consumer confidence and weaker economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 800.0, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A lower industrial production index (indicating reduced manufacturing output) compresses corporate revenue growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 2%) signals aggressive monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL < 2%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-pandemic recovery phase (defined by UNRATE falling from a peak above 15%), a rise in housing starts above 900,000 units signals accelerating economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST > 900.0 during the post-pandemic recovery phase, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.
